sources.entry: FlowForge - Deploy Node-RED applications in a reliable, scalable and secure manner. The FlowForge platform provides DevOps capabilities for Node-RED development teams. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Nodejs/Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: FlowFuse is a platform for building, deploying, and operating Node-RED applications with team collaboration, remote deployment, and DevOps pipelines.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes FlowFuse as a platform built on Node-RED for developing and operating industrial applications. It supports multiple developers working together on a single Node-RED instance. It can automate deployment of standardized Node-RED snapshots across edge devices and multiple remote locations with centralized control. It includes integrated CI/CD pipelines for managing development, test, and production environments. It provides built-in monitoring, audit trails, and role-based access controls. It also advertises AI-assisted features such as code generation from natural language, data transformation, and dashboard generation. It is offered as a managed cloud service (FlowFuse Cloud) or as a self-hosted solution.
use_cases: deploy Node-RED flows to edge devices
collaborate on Node-RED development in a team
manage dev, test, and production Node-RED environments
remote management of industrial IoT applications
build dashboards and KPIs from industrial data
audit and role-based access for Node-RED deployments
notable: Centralized remote deployment of standardized Node-RED snapshots to many edge devices
Multi-developer collaboration on a single Node-RED instance
Integrated CI/CD pipelines for Node-RED environments
Available as FlowFuse Cloud or self-hosted
caveats: Some features, including the AI assistant and professional support, are described as product offerings; the README does not detail which require a paid tier.
Self-hosting setup steps are not included in the README; it links to external documentation.
